claims.content: The VMU User views the sales history of a particular distributor, including summary details such as Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.

goal.raw_text: The VMU User views the sales history of a particular distributor, including summary details such as Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.

claims.content: VMU User
The distributor whose sales history is to be reviewed must already exist in the system (Distributor Master) so that they can be selected from the grid.
The VMU User must have access to the distributor screen where the grid of distributors is displayed.
The VMU User selects a particular distributor from the grid by double-clicking on it to view the sales history details.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User selects a particular distributor from the grid by double-clicking on it to view the sales history details.

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the distributor screen where the grid of distributors is displayed.
The VMU User selects a particular distributor from the grid by double-clicking on it.
The system displays the Sales History of the selected distributor, showing summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.
After viewing the sales history report, if the VMU User has appropriate login permissions, they may choose to print the report.

At any point during the review process, the VMU User may perform general screen operations such as creating new records, editing existing records, or deleting records (provided no child records exist), as these options are available on every screen.

The VMU User has successfully viewed the Sales History of the selected distributor, which displays summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.
The Distributor Name is displayed as the Report Header for the viewed sales history.
